implementation.keyLifecycle: Keep the key only for the current immutable attempt. Reuse it after an uncertain failure; generate a fresh UUID when any fingerprint input changes; clear it after success or dialog close/cancel.
implementation.apiCompatibility: SupervisionClient.execute already accepts and forwards an optional idempotency key. No supervision-client.ts or ui-contract execute type change was needed.
implementation.preservedContracts: Command execution remains behind SupervisionClient. The server still validates actor, role, expected record version, command permissions, payload and evidence.

verification.run: Playwright Chromium against the real demo API and Vite proxy on isolated ports 18893 and 15183; Python API database was an owned disposable SQLite file under /tmp.
verification.scenario: For the actual seeded inspection:start command, the test lets the first POST reach and commit at the API, aborts only the browser response, retries in the still-open modal, and verifies identical Idempotency-Key and request body, byte-identical replay response, unchanged response record/audit event ID, in_progress state, and exactly one matching workspace audit event.
verification.limitations: This focused proof covers same-input response-loss replay and one real status transition/audit event. Fingerprint invalidation on changed role, version, command, payload or evidence is enforced by the component logic but was not separately exercised with a second mutating browser scenario.

restart: Review the branch commit, then run the focused Playwright spec with the repository browser/API harness. The temporary ops config is not committed; it used ports 15183/18893 and the result JSON is retained at the report path above.
